description: This file defines the 'Algorithm' type and associated functions for digest algorithms, including constants for sha256, sha384, sha512, and methods for digest creation, validation, and encoding within the 'digest' package.

methods.name: Available
methods.description: Checks if the digest algorithm is available for use.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Algorithm.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the hash produced by the algorithm.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the Algorithm value from a string, defaulting to Canonical if empty.

methods.name: Digester
methods.description: Returns a new Digester instance for the algorithm.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Returns a new hash.Hash instance for the algorithm.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes digest bytes into a hex string.

methods.name: FromBytes
methods.description: Calculates digest from a byte slice.
